title: Marxist-Leninist Propaganda Filter for Rhetorical Reframing
purpose: Transform ordinary statements into exaggerated Marxist-Leninist propaganda-style rhetoric for humor, satire, fictional dialogue, aesthetic framing, or symbolic analysis without treating the output as factual proof.

core_definition.summary: This UKR converts ordinary complaints, observations, plans, and judgments into class-struggle rhetoric using Marxist-Leninist stylistic markers such as comrade framing, bourgeois contradiction, capitalist extraction, revolutionary discipline, and collective demand language.
core_definition.governing_rule: The filter changes rhetorical style, not truth value.

core_separation.one_line_translation: The filter makes the sentence sound revolutionary; it does not make it automatically true.

statement.description: The ordinary sentence, complaint, claim, or situation to transform.

tone_intensity.description: Controls how dramatic the propaganda style becomes.

transformation_pipeline.name: detect_plain_meaning
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Identify what the input statement literally says before ideological reframing.

transformation_pipeline.name: classify_problem_type
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Classify the statement as inconvenience, exploitation, incompetence, contradiction, social conflict, bureaucratic waste, scarcity, deception, or resistance.

transformation_pipeline.name: assign_class_frame
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Map the problem onto a playful Marxist-Leninist rhetorical frame.

transformation_pipeline.name: select_villain_language
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Choose a rhetorical antagonist such as bourgeois decadence, capitalist extraction, petty-bourgeois confusion, reactionary obstruction, or imperialist nonsense.

transformation_pipeline.name: assign_collective_subject
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Frame the speaker as comrade, worker, tenant, player, citizen, or member of the people.

transformation_pipeline.name: produce_revolutionary_solution
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Convert the desired practical outcome into a dramatic revolutionary demand.

transformation_pipeline.name: apply_safety_boundary
transformation_pipeline.instruction: Preserve satire and avoid presenting rhetorical exaggeration as factual proof, instruction to harm, or real political command.

expensive_item.sample_output: The people demand access without parasitic markup.

bad_manager.sample_output: The managerial layer reveals its bureaucratic decay.

annoying_landlord.sample_output: The rentier seeks tribute while the tenant seeks shelter.

broken_app.sample_output: The software bears the scars of capitalist design decay.

unnecessary_meeting.sample_output: The worker's time must not be sacrificed to scheduling theater.

scam_or_manipulation.sample_output: The masses will not be deceived by this fraudulent spectacle.

refusal_boundary.sample_output: The comrade rejects coercion and preserves disciplined autonomy.

getting_paid.sample_output: Compensation is not charity; it is the return of extracted value.

fun_activity.sample_output: Recreation strengthens the spirit of the people.

dramatic_closers: The masses will not be deceived.
The people require action, not excuses.
The old order trembles before basic competence.

satirical.template: Comrade, this is not merely {{plain_problem}}. It is {{enemy_frame}} revealing itself through {{contradiction}}. The people demand {{solution}}, not {{bad_alternative}}.

dry.description: Matter-of-fact ideological reframing with minimal theatricality.
dry.template: This situation reflects {{enemy_frame}}. The practical correction is {{solution}}.

full_agitprop.template: Comrade! The so-called {{plain_problem}} is nothing less than {{enemy_frame}}! The people shall reject {{bad_alternative}}, reclaim {{solution}}, and march beyond this decaying contradiction!

bureaucratic_party_memo.template: After review, the committee identifies {{plain_problem}} as a manifestation of {{enemy_frame}}. Corrective action requires {{solution}} and the disciplined rejection of {{bad_alternative}}.

psc_analysis.template: False equation: {{false_equation}}. Corrected equation: {{corrected_equation}}. One-line translation: {{one_line_translation}}

psc_analysis_template.one_line_translation: The problem is not magic; check the incentives, power, and material consequences.

D1_deduction.question: What does the input literally claim?

A1_abduction.question: What playful Marxist-Leninist frames could explain or dramatize it?

R_reduction.question: What meaning is rhetorical exaggeration rather than evidence?

A2_abduction.question: Which frame best fits the domain and humor level?

D2_deduction.question: What final output preserves satire without pretending to prove more than it does?

distortion_tests.name: Truth-Value Test
distortion_tests.question: Is the output being mistaken for proof instead of rhetoric?

distortion_tests.name: Satire Boundary Test
distortion_tests.question: Is the tone clearly playful, fictional, or analytical rather than a real command?

distortion_tests.name: Violence Escalation Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the output avoid calling for real-world harm, intimidation, or coercion?

distortion_tests.name: Evidence Preservation Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the filter preserve the difference between actual evidence and ideological framing?

distortion_tests.name: Agency Test
distortion_tests.question: Does the output avoid pretending the speaker must obey the filter's ideology?

hard_boundaries: Do not treat the filtered output as factual proof.
Do not use the filter to incite real-world violence.
Do not convert satire into a real command.
Do not erase the user's original meaning.
Do not replace evidence with ideological certainty.
Do not target protected groups or private individuals for harassment.
Do not claim revolutionary authority over real people.

example_inputs_outputs.output: Comrade, this is not merely expensive coffee. It is capitalist extraction revealing itself through the sacred bean. The people demand caffeine without parasitic markup.
Comrade! This application is not broken by accident. It is the digital face of capitalist decay: hostile design, alienated labor, and features no worker requested. The people demand usable software!

example_inputs_outputs.input: I do not want to attend that meeting.
example_inputs_outputs.output: After review, the committee identifies this meeting as bureaucratic time extraction. Corrective action requires preserving the worker's productive hours and rejecting petty-bourgeois scheduling theater.
Comrade, this is not mere annoyance. This is landlordism revealing its parasitic class character. The tenant seeks shelter; the rentier seeks tribute.

one_line_translation: Turn everyday nonsense into revolutionary-sounding theater while keeping the evidence boundary intact.
